Restriction-adaptive shrinkage in a high-dimensional linear model

Source: R/fit-hd-shrinkage.R
fit_hd_shrinkage.Rd

fit_hd_shrinkage() fits one full square-root lasso with all columns of X. The submodel endpoint is the restriction projection of that full estimator; it is never re-fitted on a reduced design. The endpoints can be the regularized full/projection pair or, for a zero-coordinate restriction, a full one-step debiased estimator and its projection. A debiased Wald statistic is available for fixed, small restriction dimension. A multiplier-bootstrap maximum test is used for a large coordinate block and does not form a q by q covariance matrix. Neither branch uses ordinary, ridge, or generalized ridge regression.

Usage

fit_hd_shrinkage(
  X,
  y,
  restricted_set,
  C = NULL,
  t = NULL,
  endpoint = c("regularized", "debiased_models"),
  lambda = NULL,
  lambda_node = NULL,
  test = c("auto", "wald", "max"),
  precision = c("nodewise", "diagonal", "user"),
  theta_rows = NULL,
  precision_fit = NULL,
  full_model_precision_fit = NULL,
  submodel_precision_fit = NULL,
  assume_independent = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  bootstrap_B = 999L,
  bootstrap_seed = NULL,
  bootstrap_multipliers = NULL,
  bootstrap_block_size = 256L,
  fixed_q_max = 10L,
  penalty_factor = NULL,
  max_iter = 30000L,
  tol = 5e-06,
  check_every = 50L,
  verbose = FALSE,
  full_beta_init = NULL,
  restricted_beta_init = NULL,
  full_operator_norm = NULL,
  restricted_operator_norm = NULL,
  epsilon = 1e-10
)

Arguments

X

Numeric n by p design matrix.

y

Numeric response vector of length n.

restricted_set

One-based indices M involved in the restriction.

C

Optional q by length(M) contrast matrix. NULL means the coordinate restriction beta[M] = t, whose projection is implemented without constructing a q by q matrix.

t

Null target. It defaults to zero.

endpoint

Shrinkage endpoints. "regularized" uses the full square-root lasso and its restriction projection. "debiased_models" computes one full-model debiased estimator and projects it to the coordinate zero subspace. The latter currently requires a coordinate zero-block restriction.

lambda

Square-root lasso penalty.

lambda_node

Nodewise lasso penalty.

test

One of "auto", "wald", or "max". Automatic selection uses Wald only when q <= fixed_q_max.

precision

One of "nodewise", "diagonal", or "user".

theta_rows

User precision rows for precision = "user".

precision_fit

Optional reusable result from estimate_precision_rows().

full_model_precision_fit

Optional reusable all-row precision result for the standardized full design when endpoint = "debiased_models".

submodel_precision_fit

Deprecated compatibility argument. It is ignored because no separate submodel debiasing fit is performed.

assume_independent

Required for diagonal precision. This is suitable for a design whose diagonal population precision is assumed in advance, such as the Gaussian iid simulation design.

alpha

Test level.

bootstrap_B

Number of multiplier draws for the maximum test.

bootstrap_seed

Optional seed used without changing the caller's RNG state.

bootstrap_multipliers

Optional reusable n by bootstrap_B Gaussian multiplier matrix.

bootstrap_block_size

Number of multiplier draws processed in one C++ block.

fixed_q_max

Largest restriction dimension selected for Wald by test = "auto".

penalty_factor

Nonnegative square-root lasso penalty factors.

max_iter

Maximum primal-dual iterations.

tol

Solver tolerance.

check_every

Iteration interval for convergence diagnostics.

verbose

Print periodic solver diagnostics.

full_beta_init

Optional original-scale warm start for the full fit.

restricted_beta_init

Deprecated compatibility argument. It is ignored because the restricted endpoint is projected from the full fit.

full_operator_norm

Optional reusable full-design operator norm.

restricted_operator_norm

Deprecated compatibility argument. It is ignored because no restricted-design solver is run.

epsilon

Positive numerical floor used only in a shrinkage denominator.

Value

An object of class hd_shrinkage_fit containing the regularized and selected full/submodel endpoints, the available adaptive estimators, full solver and projection diagnostics, precision directions, and inference output.

Details

Let A beta = t denote the restriction and let V denote the projection geometry. The conceptual restricted endpoint is $$\hat\beta^{SM}=\hat\beta^F- V A^T(A V A^T)^\dagger(A\hat\beta^F-t).$$ The implementation uses Euclidean geometry after internal column standardization. For beta[M] = t, this simply replaces the selected coordinates of the all-X full estimate by t; all other coordinates are inherited exactly from the full fit.

For a large coordinate restriction, the max-calibrated estimators are $$\hat\beta^{S_\infty}=\hat\beta^{SM}+ (1-a^*/(T_{\max}^2\vee\epsilon)) (\hat\beta^{FM}-\hat\beta^{SM})$$ and its positive-part version. The separately reported protected version equals the full endpoint when the max test rejects and otherwise equals the positive-part estimator. Here a* is the conditional mean of the squared multiplier-bootstrap maximum. These estimators are experimental; the package does not assert classical James–Stein dominance for them.

The restricted set must be specified independently of the response used for inference. If it is selected from data, sample splitting or external information is required for the advertised test interpretation.

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 70), 40, 70)
beta <- c(rep(1, 4), rep(0, 66))
y <- drop(X %*% beta + rnorm(40))
fit <- fit_hd_shrinkage(
  X, y,
  restricted_set = 5:70,
  test = "max",
  precision = "diagonal",
  assume_independent = TRUE,
  bootstrap_B = 99,
  max_iter = 5000,
  tol = 1e-4
)
coef(fit, method = "PS")
coef(fit, method = "PPS")
